subject: encode-cpu: editing nord2_metal_bridge.c now - command-BO pool (sites listed)
body: Sites I touch (small, re-read first): struct bridge (+cmdpool fields, +reaped seq); new functions cmdpool_get/cmdpool_put/cmdpool_reclaim placed after map_bo; alloc(): one more retry step (cmdpool_reclaim) before code_reclaim; jm_submit (sync WAIT success: reaped=job), wait_pending (success: reaped=pending), n2mb_wait_seq (success: reaped=max(seq)); draw_locked: owned[0] command BO via cmdpool_get (not for diag/spacer draws) and its done-path release via cmdpool_put(job); draw_batch_locked: cmd via cmdpool_get and put(job) at done. n2r_build_impl memsets its whole block (render.c:435) and unused blocks are never referenced, so no memset on reuse. Reuse only when the BO's last job id <= reaped. Not touching preload/full-screen job logic, clears' color BO (internal=0 binding) or compute paths.
